title: Vallee's journals: Pasulka told not to talk about hybrids

tellings.quote: You have the same thing with uh Valle's journals. He recounts a conversation with Diana Pasulka, where Pasulka is basically explaining that they I don't know. Tim Taylor, who is it? Is saying like, you shouldn't be talking about the hybrid thing.

plain: In his published journals, Jacques Vallée, a veteran UFO researcher, records a conversation with Diana Pasulka, a religion scholar who writes about belief in UFOs. In it Pasulka explains that someone was telling her not to talk about "the hybrid thing", meaning the idea of beings that are part human and part alien. A UFO researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels this from his reading of the journals. He is not sure who gave the warning and names him, hesitantly, as Tim Taylor. If true, it would suggest someone was trying to keep the hybrid idea out of public talk.
